info.title: AcornOps Control Plane API
info.description: Control plane API for workspaces, targets, Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, sessions, runs, auth, and internal execution wiring.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: OIDC, password, browser session, and external integration account link endpoints.

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Workspace, target, Kubernetes cluster, and VM management endpoints.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Best-effort webhook subscription and delivery history endpoints.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Run query, cancel, and stream endpoints.

tags.name: workflows
tags.description: Workspace workflow definitions, schedules, sessions, and approval inbox endpoints.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: MCP registries, destination-bound browsing, scoped MCP imports, and personal MCP connections.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Workspace-scoped custom agent definitions, triggers, versions, tests, and activity.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Operator-only admin API protected exclusively by admin bearer tokens.

post.description: Verification tokens are bearer secrets. Browser clients must send them only over HTTPS outside local development.

200.description: Generic success or throttled response with optional resendAfterSeconds.

post.summary: Request a password reset email
post.description: The response is enumeration-safe for unknown, OIDC-only, verified password, and pending password accounts. Only password-backed users receive a token.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: CSRF token returned by /api/v1/auth/csrf and mirrored in the CSRF cookie.

200.description: Generic success or throttled response with optional resendAfterSeconds.

post.summary: Set a new password using a password reset token
post.description: Reset tokens are bearer secrets. Successful reset verifies the account email, consumes outstanding reset and verification tokens for the same user/email, and revokes browser sessions.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: CSRF token returned by /api/v1/auth/csrf and mirrored in the CSRF cookie.

post.summary: Create an external integration account link token
post.description: Client-token endpoint for a registered external integration client. The client submits its own stable external user id and receives a management-console URL that starts browser authentication.

200.description: Short-lived external integration account link URL for the user to open in a browser.

400.description: Invalid external integration account link payload.

401.description: Missing or invalid external integration client token.

post.summary: Resolve an external user link
post.description: Client-token endpoint for a registered external integration client. The client submits its own stable external user id and receives whether that identity is durably linked to an AcornOps user.

200.description: Linked or unlinked external integration account status.

401.description: Missing or invalid external integration client token.

post.summary: Preview an external integration account link
post.description: Authenticated browser-session endpoint used by the management console to display safe consent metadata before explicit approval.

200.description: Safe external integration link consent metadata.

400.description: Invalid external integration link preview payload.

410.description: External integration link token is expired, consumed, invalidated, or unavailable.

post.summary: Complete an external integration account link
post.description: Authenticated browser-session endpoint used by the management console after password or OIDC sign-in and explicit user approval. It consumes a valid short-lived external integration link token and binds the external user id to the signed-in AcornOps user.

400.description: Invalid external integration link completion payload.

410.description: External integration link token is expired, consumed, invalidated, or unavailable.

get.summary: List linked external integrations
get.description: Authenticated browser-session endpoint returning active external integration links for the signed-in user.

post.summary: Unlink an external integration account
post.description: Authenticated browser-session endpoint that revokes one active external integration link owned by the signed-in user.

post.summary: Revoke an external integration account link
post.description: Client-token endpoint for a registered external integration client to revoke one identity link scoped to that client.

401.description: Missing or invalid external integration client token.

List AcornOps workspace-native tools
get.description: Returns the code-owned native-tool catalog. Requires workspace read access.

delete.summary: Revoke a workspace-native tool from a specialist Agent
delete.description: Disables reviewed mappings that depend on the tool and recomputes dependent readiness.

get.summary: List automation templates and setup state
get.description: Returns automatic and opt-in templates, setup steps, accepted integration profiles, blocker codes, and installation state. Automatic templates are provisioned with the workspace; opt-in definitions are absent until installed.

post.summary: Install or explicitly reinstall an automation template
post.description: Idempotently creates paused definitions for opt-in templates. Requires manage_agents and manage_workflows.

post.summary: Activate an installed automation template
post.description: Activation succeeds only when reviewed workspace prerequisites are ready.

get.summary: List active workspace agents

get.summary: List workspaces available to current user

200.description: Workspace page payload: { items, nextCursor? }. Workspace items include plan.{key,name} and quota.{members,kubernetesClusters,virtualMachines}.{used,limit}; operational quota usage is redacted to 0 when permissions.read_workspace_data is false, and member usage requires permissions.read_members.

409.description: Workspace membership quota exceeded. Returns QUOTA_EXCEEDED with quotaKey=workspaceMemberships.

get.summary: Get a workspace summary available to current user

200.description: Workspace summary, including plan.{key,name}, permissions, bounded list counts, and quota.{members,kubernetesClusters,virtualMachines}.{used,limit}. Operational counts and operational quota usage are redacted when permissions.read_workspace_data is false; member counts and quota usage require permissions.read_members.

404.description: Workspace not found or not accessible.

get.summary: List workspace members

schema.description: Deployment-supported workspace role key. Built-ins are owner, admin, operator, viewer, and auditor; custom roles are lowercase snake_case.

get.summary: List workflow definitions for a workspace
get.description: Returns system-provided template-origin and manually created workflow definitions visible to management-console. Requires read_workspace_data.

post.summary: Create a workspace workflow definition
post.description: Creates a Workflow V2 definition from one or more active reviewed specialist Agent IDs. One Agent runs directly; multiple Agents are coordinated by AcornOps. Selection order has no meaning and executionMode is derived. Requires manage_workflows.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Compatibility field accepted but ignored. The deployment-wide AGENT_MAX_RUNTIME_MS setting is authoritative.

retentionDays.description: Compatibility field accepted but ignored. The deployment-wide report retention setting is authoritative.

get.summary: List server-compiled workflow options
get.description: Returns workflow options. Runtime and retention policy lists contain the single effective deployment-wide value. When agentId is supplied, MCP servers, exact tool references, and skills are limited to that Agent’s installed capability ceiling. The endpoint never exposes catalog installation actions.

get.summary: List workflow schedules for a workspace
get.description: Returns control-plane-owned workflow schedules and summary metrics. Requires read_workspace_data.

post.summary: Create workflow schedule
post.description: Creates a scheduled workflow automation. Requires manage_workflows.

patch.description: Updates schedule cadence, enabled state, workflow, grants, or defaults. Requires manage_workflows.

post.summary: Preview a workflow schedule
post.description: Validates workflow inputs, context grants, cron, and timezone without creating or changing a schedule.

200.description: Schedule validation, readable summary, and upcoming run times.

get.summary: List workspace approval inbox
get.description: Normalizes target write-tool approvals and workflow approval gates into a single workspace inbox. pendingCount is the total pending count across both sources before pagination and is independent of the requested status filter. Decisions remain on the run-scoped approval decision endpoint.

get.summary: Get a workflow definition

patch.description: Manual workflows accept definition edits. System-provided workflows accept availability-status changes only; duplicate one to edit its definition.

maxRuntimeSeconds.description: Compatibility field accepted but ignored. The deployment-wide AGENT_MAX_RUNTIME_MS setting is authoritative.

retentionDays.description: Compatibility field accepted but ignored. The deployment-wide report retention setting is authoritative.

409.description: System-provided workflow definition is immutable; duplicate it to edit.

post.summary: Duplicate a workflow as a custom draft
post.description: Copies the effective definition only. Runs, sessions, schedules, triggers, activity, and version history are not copied.

201.description: Custom draft created and owned by the current user.

post.summary: Preview the effective workflow capability scope
post.description: Compiles a non-reserving, secret-free snapshot of semantic capabilities, eligible targets, exact effective tools, direct MCP attachments, skills, and approval requirements. The stored target type is authoritative. Requires read_workspace_data and the same run-creation capability as launch. Dispatch always recompiles and remains authoritative.

200.description: Workflow capability compatibility and effective access preview.

403.description: The current workspace role cannot read workspace data or create this run mode.
